summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of Checkbox Filtering feature on Comparison page. All 12 test scenarios passed successfully.
passed_tests: Filter button shows 'X of Y selected' text (e.g., '128 of 128 selected')
Clicking filter button opens popover with checkboxes for each item
Popover shows dynamic header based on compare_by (e.g., 'Select Districts', 'Select Sources')
Popover shows 'All' and 'None' buttons for bulk selection
Each popover item shows name and current sales count (e.g., Patna - 81)
Clicking 'None' deselects all items (shows '0 of 128 selected')
Clicking 'All' selects all items (shows '128 of 128 selected')
Individual checkbox toggles update the filter count correctly
Overall Summary card recalculates totals based on selected items (6,800→5,830 potential when 2 items deselected)
Chart updates to show only selected items (excluded Patna/Raipur from chart)
Table rows have checkbox column with data-testid='row-checkbox-{idx}'
Table header has select-all checkbox with data-testid='select-all-checkbox'
Unchecked rows appear dimmed (opacity-40 class applied)
Row checkbox toggle syncs with filter button count
Switching Compare by to Dealer loads new data with auto-select all (128 of 128)
Switching Compare by to Source loads 14 items with auto-select all
Switching Compare by to Segment loads 16 items with auto-select all
Switching Compare by to State loads 16 items with auto-select all
critical_code_review_comments: Checkbox filtering implementation is well structured using React state (selectedItems as Set)
filteredComparisonData and filteredTotals correctly use useMemo for performance
All interactive elements have proper data-testid attributes for testing
Auto-select all items when compareBy changes is properly handled in useEffect
context_for_next_testing_agent: Checkbox filtering feature on Comparison page is fully functional. Key data-testid selectors: filter-items-btn (filter button), select-all-btn/deselect-all-btn (popover buttons), select-all-checkbox (table header), row-checkbox-{idx} (table rows). Summary card shows filtered indicator when items are deselected. Chart and table properly filter based on selection. All compare_by options (district, dealer, source, segment, state) work correctly with auto-select all behavior.
